evidence.note: Credential comes from Extension.CurrentCredential(); for AuthenticationKind UsernamePassword the Username and Password are placed in CredentialConnectionString as UID and PWD.
Authentication record declares only UsernamePassword = [].
Data is reached through Odbc.DataSource(ConnectionString, ...) with the MarkLogic SQL driver.
SqlCapabilities is overridden (FractionalSecondsScale = 3) and passed to Odbc.DataSource.
SQLGetInfo overrides are defined (SQL_CONVERT_*, SQL_SQL92_PREDICATES, SQL_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS, SQL_GROUP_BY, SQL_DATETIME_LITERALS) and passed to Odbc.DataSource.
The data source function takes server (host name, url-or-server) and port (numeric port of the ODBC server). No database, options, region, or date-range parameter exists.
Rows are returned as tables from the ODBC driver via Odbc.DataSource. No other format is parsed.
SQLGetTypeInfo is a #table of driver type information (ODBC TYPE_NAME and DATA_TYPE codes). It describes driver metadata and does not assign M types to returned data columns.
SQLColumns passes the driver's column metadata through unchanged unless tracing is enabled, so column names and types come from the driver.
Documentation.Name and LongDescription (function documentation); FieldCaption (lines 94, 99); FieldDescription (lines 95, 100); SampleValues (lines 96, 101). No allowed-values metadata is present.
Odbc.DataSource builds the navigator at runtime from the driver catalog. HierarchicalNavigation = true makes schema rows into folders (IsLeaf false) that open table lists.
TestConnection returns { "MarkLogicODBC.Contents", server, port }, which reuses the shared data source function.
SqlCapabilities and SQLGetInfo overrides shape folding through Odbc.DataSource.
AstVisitor LimitClause rewrites LIMIT/OFFSET. Per the definition this counts as odbc-sql-capabilities, not custom-sql-generator.
Loads code from .pqm files (Diagnostics.pqm and OdbcConstants.pqm) via Extension.Contents and Expression.Evaluate.
Diagnostics.pqm and OdbcConstants.pqm are loaded through Extension.LoadFunction.
Labels and button text come from Extension.LoadString resource strings.
Icon16 and Icon32 are PNG files loaded with Extension.Contents.
Switch is false by default.
Diagnostics[LogValue] (which calls Diagnostics.Trace in Diagnostics.pqm line 2) is used only when EnableTraceOutput is true; otherwise it is a no-op.
The SQLColumns handler returns source unless EnableTraceOutput is true before any Diagnostics.LogValue call runs.
